title: From Toronto: Algonquin Park and Ragged Falls Hike and Canoe
includes: Entry permit for Algonquin provincial Park
Guided Canoe Trip to Ragged Falls
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

We suggest bringing some snacks with you to sustain the day. While we'll make a stop for a washroom/grocery break, it's worth noting that the Canoe and Hike experience lasts 3 hours from approx 11 - 2. A picnic on the hike is a good idea (not included) so planning for that is a suggestion. The visitor centre does have a cafeteria and a microwave if you'd like to heat food up. They have a donation system for the items available but please note, it is somewhat limited.
We will have another local guide join us in Oxtongue Provincial Park to help animate your adventure and steer your large canoe
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the natural beauty of Algonquin Provincial Park and Ragged Falls on this immersive day trip from Toronto. Enjoy a scenic hike along picturesque trails, take a large group canoe ride on the Oxtongue River, and marvel at the powerful Ragged Falls. The journey includes a visit to the Algonquin Visitor Center and a short hike to a stunning lookout point. Travel in comfort aboard our customized 14-passenger transit, equipped with basic WiFi, entertainment options, and a knowledgeable driver guide to enhance your experience.

- Scenic hiking and canoeing in Algonquin Provincial Park
- Visit the powerful Ragged Falls and Algonquin Visitor Center
- Comfortable transport with programming, and entertainment options on board
- Small group experience with regular washroom breaks
